delay_definition: old measured capture-to-readiness residual minus old complete network time plus inverse new serial marginal CDF at old same-image-count concurrent marginal midrank; add unchanged0.02s apply overhead only when predicting selected action age
assumptions: Modeled sensitivity condition, not measured new concurrent API performance.
Same-image-count network latency ranks/copula and historical non-network readiness residuals are transported unchanged; this may miss concurrency-dependent changes.
Old marginal uses actual historical concurrent candidate meta.total_s, not serial minima.
One-image and two-image new serial marginals each contain one observation; constant mapping is conservative relative to selecting a faster value but is not a tail bound.
Three-image new serial empirical inverse CDF is linearly interpolated with no tail extrapolation;19samples cannot establish rare tails.
Historical non-network overhead may differ under compact ledger/shared inputs; no unverified speedup is assumed.
Profile data must not reveal any actual sampled vector or future state to the player model.
